name: inspect_controllers
description: Read what can write or override each device: program chips on its data networks (a pin or db naming it, an id, a batch write to its prefab hash, with its name hash for sbn), logic writers whose output it is, batch writers of its prefab, and mirrors set to it. Each controller gives kind, reference_id, logic_type, via (db, d0 to d5, id, the batch instruction, output, prefab_hash, mirror) and a chip's 0-based line. Pass exactly one of reference_id, reference_ids or network_id; a network lists only its devices that have a controller, and checked counts every device looked at. A pin or batch through a register, a computed device register (dr0) and a logic type given as a number are not resolved.

reference_ids.description: Up to 256 devices, each listed in order; an id that names no device carries its error.

network_id.description: A cable network's id: every data device on it that has a controller.
